title: Unique compatible section lift of quotient morphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal, and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the completion quotient systems and projections of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], with positive levels $n+1$. Let $\mathcal H=\mathcal Hom(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and suppose given maps $e_n:\mathcal H/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal H\to\mathcal Hom(\mathcal G/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal G,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal F)$ whose composites with $q_{n+1}^{\mathcal H}$ and precomposition with $q_{n+1}^{\mathcal G}$ equal postcomposition with $q_{n+1}^{\mathcal F}$. For every family $t_n:\mathcal G/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal G\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal F$ commuting with all transition maps, there exists exactly one compatible family of global sections $s_n$ of $\mathcal H/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal H$ whose images under $\Gamma(e_n)$ and the global internal-Hom identification equal $t_n$ for every $n$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0882 (lemma-completion-internal-hom, line 6438); the map is left implicit in Stacks and is written out here; the proof there works affine-locally via Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Algebra, Lemma 00MB (lemma-completion-flat) with More on Algebra, Lemma 087R (more-algebra-lemma-pseudo-coherence-and-base-change-ext) for Hom_A(M,N) (x) A^ = Hom_{A^}(M (x) A^, N (x) A^)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-completion-internal-hom-affine-sections-lift] to t on every affine open U, obtaining a unique compatible family l_U of sections of the completed Hom quotients on U.

Restrict l_U to an affine V contained in U. Naturality of e_n and of the sections corresponding to t_n shows that the restricted family solves the same local lifting equations on V; naturality of transition maps preserves its compatibility. Local uniqueness identifies it with l_V. For an arbitrary common subopen of two affine opens, refine by affine opens and use sheaf separatedness to show their sections agree.

The affine opens cover X. At every level glue the compatible local family using Mathlib Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible.existsUnique_section on the underlying type-valued sheaf. The transition equations and the evaluation equations hold after restriction to each affine open, hence globally by CoversTop.sections_ext. Any competing compatible global lift restricts to l_U by local uniqueness; the same sheaf extensionality gives equality at every level. Transport the evaluation equality back through homObjSectionsEquiv.
